question: In a triangle ABC, BD is perpendicular to AC. E is a point on BC such that angle BEA = xº. If angle EAC = 38º and angle EBD = 40º, then the value of x is:
solution:
Given:

∠BEA = x°, ∠EAC = 38°, ∠EBD = 40°

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f9090b07236b38edaeca0d5873c5946dd053079910fd29b903890fba7efa197.png] 

In ΔBDC

⇒ 40° + 90° + ∠C = 180° (sum of all the angles in a triangle is 180°)

⇒ ∠C = 50°

In ΔAEC

⇒ 38° + 50° + ∠AEC = 180°

⇒ ∠AEC = 92°

Now,

⇒ x° + 92° = 180° (angles on a straight line)

⇒ x° = 88°
